messages:
Zoe (Product Designer): hey team! first day — quick setup/help please: 1) how do i get Figma access (SSO?) 2) where's the canonical product roadmap doc? 3) who should I bug about research briefs and recruiting? cc @Hector

Hector (Design Lead): welcome Zoe!! :tada: Figma is via Okta SSO. Steps: Okta -> Apps -> Request 'Figma (Redwood)'. If it shows pending ping @Mina. I'll invite you to 'Redwood Product Kit' and the 'Pattern Library' once your account is active.

Mina (Design Ops): Hi Zoe 44b Auto-approve usually completes within an hour during weekdays. If pending after 30 mins DM me and i'll manually invite. Figma team name: "Redwood - Product". Also added the onboarding checklist to your mailbox.

Omar (PM): Roadmap lives in Confluence: /product/strategy/roadmap. We keep a short 'what's running now' section and a changelog of decisions. If you want I can do a 15-min walkthrough of current bets at 2pm PT.

Zoe (Product Designer): 2pm PT works, thx! for research: do briefs live in Drive or Confluence? who owns recruitment?

Hector (Design Lead): Briefs are in Drive -> design/research/playbooks. Process: PMs create a short brief (problem, users, primary question), post to #design-research with the tag "study-request". Design Ops (Mina) handles screener + recruitment or we use the internal panel for quick tests.

Mina (Design Ops): quick note: templates live in the playbook folder (brief-template.md, screener-template.md, consent.txt). For remote moderated studies we use Miro + Zoom; for unmoderated we use UserTesting. If you need help writing a screener, ping me and I'll pair.

Access Bot: Access request received: 'Figma' submitted by Zoe. Ticket #ACC-9821. Est. processing 1-2 hours.

Zoe (Product Designer): requested via Okta, currently pending. Mina i'll DM the ticket id. thanks everyone 60a

Mina (Design Ops): Manual approval completed, invite sent to your email. Added you to Pattern Library and Product Kit. Also added you to the recurring "Design Crit" invite.

Zoe (Product Designer): got the invite and Drive access. saw the brief templates, will draft one for a quick nav test and drop it in #design-research. excited to be here!
